---
name: Work autonomously end-to-end
description: User prefers autonomous execution without asking permission at each step — just do the work
type: feedback
---

When given a multi-step task, execute the entire thing end-to-end without asking for approval at each step. Only pause if there's a genuine blocker or cost decision.

**Why:** User finds repeated "shall I proceed?" prompts disruptive to flow.
**How to apply:** Complete full tasks autonomously. Present results when done, not plans before starting.
